outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to describe and evaluate the fundamental concepts of the refrigeration cycle.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to employ a systematic approach to troubleshooting a HVAC/R system malfunction and prepare an effective repair solution.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to read and interpret electrical diagrams in various technical formats and be able to analyze various electrical failures typical to HVAC/R equipment.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to pass the required Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) certification exam for refrigerants.
